title: A product artifact treaty records by version and hash
description: Code one product ships to another as a built file, such as a JavaScript embed, which treaty does not describe by shape. Treaty records where it is built, the version and commit, and each file's SHA-256, so a consumer's pin can be compared with it. The record lives at contracts/artifacts/<name>.json and the crossing it belongs to lists it in `contract`.

artifact.description: The record's own name: its file is contracts/artifacts/<artifact>.json.

crossing.description: The registry crossing the artifact belongs to.

owner.description: The product that builds it: the crossing's owner.

version.description: The artifact's own version where it is built (its package.json), as major.minor.patch.

commit.description: The owner's commit the files were built from.

files.description: Each built file's name and SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex).

vendoredBy.description: Each consumer's pin of these files, as <repo>:<path>.
